mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, sku VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, stock INT NOT NULL CHECK (stock >= 0), version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, sku, stock, version FROM inventory
AND sku LIKE CONCAT(#{skuPrefix}, '%')
AND stock >= #{minimumStock}
ORDER BY stock DESC, sku ASC
ORDER BY sku ASC
